headline: Epidemic of type 3 paralytic poliomyelitis in Baltimore, Maryland, 1960
blurb: Four authors published a report in Public Health Reports in April 1962 on an epidemic of type 3 paralytic polio in Baltimore in 1960.

headline: Control of a measles outbreak in an elementary school. Baltimore County, Md. 1975.
blurb: Between April 18 and May 20, 1975, 16 measles cases occurred among pupils at an elementary school in Baltimore County, and one more case occurred in a sibling at a junior high school.

headline: Pertussis -- Maryland, 1982
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: Maryland received reports of 79 whooping cough cases in 1982, up from 1 to 18 cases a year in the previous 10 years, and 76% of the patients were under 1 year old.

headline: IRVING DAVIS, SR. v. STATE OF MARYLAND
source: Court of Appeals of Maryland (via the Harvard Law School Caselaw Access Project)
blurb: Maryland's highest court ruled that the religious exemption in the state's school immunization law, which covered only members of a recognized church or denomination, was invalid, and that the immunization requirement itself stayed in force.

headline: Pertussis Outbreaks -- Massachusetts and Maryland, 1992
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: After a 10-year-old student's whooping cough was reported to Maryland health officials on November 16, 1992, investigators confirmed four cases at the elementary school: three students and their teacher.

headline: Fourth Measles Case Confirmed in Maryland
source: Maryland Department of Health (archived by the Internet Archive)
blurb: The Maryland Department of Health confirmed a fourth measles case in a state resident and said the outbreak was localized to three zip codes.

headline: One Case of Measles Confirmed in Maryland Resident with Recent International Travel
blurb: The Maryland Department of Health and Howard County health officials announced a measles case in a Howard County resident who had recently traveled abroad, and said it was not tied to the outbreak in Texas and New Mexico.
